areas.notes: Same order as reference: header -> balance hero -> equity chart -> timeframe tabs -> Live screen -> Bots (5) -> Activity, iOS status bar, banners and tab bar. Fullscreen 1080x1920, no device frame.
Inter (SF Pro substitute) throughout; balance 128 px, sticky balance 72 px, P&L 42 px, section titles 44 px, rows 34/26 px, smallest 22 px (critic-enforced).
44-candle viewport over ~850 px plot, real OHLCV, EMA7/EMA20, RSI14, right price scale with uniform decimals, time scale, volume, crosshair + time tag, live price tag.
Triangle + pill + pulse ring; pills auto-placed to avoid candles, other markers, the price tag and legend (0 collisions in 450 frames); synced banner, feed row, sound and camera push.
Replay reveal of real candles, smoothed auto-range, marching price line, breakout band, coins fly from SELL markers into the sticky balance.
Five distinct vector icons with progress rings/bars, per-event status text, flashing row on change; Scanner cycles the verified watchlist.

5-layer scene graph with one perspective camera (dolly/crane/yaw/pitch, push-ins on trades, orbit at the finale), DOF background + dust, Blender PBR coin sprites with cast shadows, 3D page fly-out at 11.8-12.64 s; text scale >= 0.92 enforced.
Events quantized to the 1/8-note grid; screen-recording-crisp scrolls (no blur except the far-shot fly-out); end card readable from its 3rd frame.

New engine: intro/build/drop/breakdown/riser/drop B arrangement, hook, layered drums, reverb, sidechain; -14.2 LUFS, -1.6 dBTP, stereo correlation 0.77, all events on beat. Score is estimated from measurements (spectrogram, section levels) - not from listening.
Mint+pool verified on 3 sources, candles byte-identical, snapshot labelled with time, trades labelled CONCEPT/Paper, no on-chain claims.
